text:
Maya: quick thread on shared regional endpoints vs per-customer peering - need clear decision criteria for which customers get an ENI/pinned egress vs shared relay.
Owen: cost + latency + session type. if customer uses long-lived gRPC or depends on source-ip allowlists, they need pinned egress.
Rita: operationally, ENI per tenant has onboarding friction. suggest "enterprise-only" by contract. self-serve use shared relays with optional stable-ip lease for an extra fee.
Sam: stable-ip lease model: allocate a virtual stable IP from a pool, advertise it via regional relays, keep lease heartbeat. failure modes: ARP/neighbor delays on transfer, TCP resets mid-stream. document 3min warm window.
Maya: also consider TLS models: SNI passthrough preserves client certs but reduces routing visibility. maybe do SNI-pass for regulated + passthrough flag.
Owen: add constraints to RFC draft: no kernel modules, support for Ubuntu/CentOS kernels we run, clear rollback path to ENI if shared-relay shows trouble.
deploy-bot: perf job queued: shared-relay-stableip-2026-03-23 (ETA 25m)
Maya: next steps: Rita to draft cost/onboarding flow, Owen to enumerate session types and mappings, Sam to prototype lease handshake. will review Friday.
Rita: will include a small table mapping workloads -> recommended path (grpc/long-lived -> ENI; short requests -> shared+lease).
Owen: :thumbsup:
